set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-1.0; milestone-evidence.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Recovered courts landed at 9339172694484aad98e2a75f961728dbdb0012b5; original 12 historical mutation receipts were reaudited. S2a-3 now landed at a2d795b, so the remaining dependency is closed. Preserve the unrelated top-level align/ContentBehaviorLawsSuite.scala draft; it is already byte-identical to the preserved candidate law file.

Remaining / next action: Complete the unavailable-channel versus provider-abstention behavioral and mutation witness over the landed S2a-3 path; reconcile the complete S2a-4 court/mutant checklist and gate the merged tests.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Compile court from outside align (forbidden accessors refused, same-shape controls compile; four construction doors per type), JVM-reflection public-method pin + forbidden-type scan, 8 named mutants, span-shift / id-rename / permutation laws with a historical-moves control, None vs Some(empty) chart and Unavailable vs abstain distinctions. Acceptance: all mutants killed with receipts.
